set.body:
Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 2 recall-map.

No command runs from inputs to a mapping; the film mapper is run-arm.sh plus STORYMODEL4S_* environment variables (19, or 20 counting _DATA), one JVM per participant. E0's terminal courts (bd-01M1CQSWJ538PAEME49200YARR) are carried here; E0 becomes the 1.x extension of this command to a compiled film source. V1 (bd-01M1CQQDCWN2RTT1Z8XNNB7VMY) remains the film StoryModel wire (1.x); the mapping result has its own versioned schema.

Scope:
The command and its output contract. The report and the benchmark migration are the next ticket.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Inputs: a corpus descriptor and recall transcripts.
2. Output: a versioned mapping-result schema with one typed outcome per input unit -- a mapping (exact intervals, score provenance including the cost-model invocation receipt, available alternatives, typed reliability status), an abstention, an external state, or a failure; unavailable scores or reliability are explicit.
3. Exit 0 if and only if every input unit is accounted for and there is no malformed artifact or provider failure; otherwise non-zero, with the receipted partial result retained (tests for each branch).
4. The same inputs run twice give byte-identical outputs; outputs contain no media bytes (tests).
5. Sherlock parity: per-unit anchors byte-identical to the recorded all17-monofill arm.
6. CLI help and a docs-site page; the docs-site example verifies.

Gate (AGENTS.md SD2/SD6): `sbt -batch clean compileAll testAll` on the merge result, then
`sbt -batch scalafmtCheckAll scalafmtSbtCheck` as a separate run; every test task in build.sbt's
testAll alias reports bound totals (56 at 0e36a7fa, after the corpus modules were added; recount if
modules change); a named mutation witness per new guard, and each compile-time-probe mutation proved
after its own clean recompile; `cd docs-site && npm run verify:examples` when public API or examples
change; fresh-context cold review in a separate pass; the commit body states the evidence and what
it does not establish.

Size: M.
set.title: Phase 2: recall-map command -- contract, per-unit outcomes, exit codes
